name: Cubature
nameStatus: Final fork name; GitHub repository orthrus-research/Cubature, a fork of OpenCubicChunks/CubicChunks
reason: Cubature owns cubic scheduling, lighting, lifetime, storage and DH runtime compatibility/optimization patches; Riven owns generated content
scope: Exact Cubature commit; compatibility IDs, APIs, packets and world formats retained.

qualification.status: Light qualification. Built from this clean Cubature commit as Java 25 bytecode with CleanroomGradle against Cleanroom 0.7.14-alpha; all 367 Java sources in the sources artifact match the commit, and core (576) and matching-artifact lab (106) tests pass on Java 26. Its Mixins apply offline in development names and in the shipped jar through its refmap, and no injector hook differs between the two (OrthLib mixinkit). The changes since cbcb09b7 are logging, the client governor's rest with no world and the lab's stale-mesh check only, so no native capture was run on this pin; the last full qualification, on cbcb09b7, passed a native timing capture and a creative flight lifecycle capture in BASELINE on the shipping G1 profile (8 GiB, 4 MB regions, 50 ms pause target, concurrent explicit collections), and a Demonica client drew the Celeritas tour with no error.
qualification.contents: Bounded native generation, regional preparation, previews, storage and DH delivery; host-owned build pools available before biome-provider construction and preserved after adoption; save-level derived-data directory requests; cached cube classification and surface bands, used to install EMPTY cubes without generation and to order delivery visible-first; early initial light and surface tracking for empty sky cubes; retained-column preparation and urgent held teleports; exclusive server-thread phase accounting, with block ticks and player-map bookkeeping separated (the lab alone wraps vanilla call sites for network and tick-event phases), and client native-capture counters; regional preparation around spawn while no player is present; flushes that write each region's backlog in one batch, storage compression on reused deflaters and bounded workers, and regenerable empty cubes left unsaved; chunk-mesh builders that start with small layer buffers; a public random-tick listener API on the cubic pass; entity chunk-loading tickets that keep their entity's cube; a client cube source API (versioned snapshots, a held box, a settled signal) with a small client build pool and a client terrain-preview pool that share one governor of work permits, cut on frame and server-tick p95 and raised on queued work, each logging why; a terrain preview's own small build pool, stopped with it; every client pool logging a stop line as its world goes, and counting its threads still alive 1, 2, 5 and 10 seconds after while any is; a client governor that rests while no world is attached; an optional delivery of only the light that changed (off by default); the lab's named reduced view profiles below its baseline, fixed when an instance is prepared; Mixin configurations registered through a CleanMix connector, with MixinExtras wraps and Expressions in place of redirects and constant modifiers; no compatibility code for mods or platforms outside the runtime (Demonica and its Celeritas kept), no support for clients without Cubature, no upstream code that nothing calls, of the vanilla generator fixes only those a player can still reach (sapling trees and the huge mushroom), and one build (cleanroom/). Compatibility IDs, packets, save formats and the upstream DH binary are preserved.
limits: Respawn, portal and join arrivals still load their column synchronously

Client rendering and held maps remain unqualified.
